input.objective:
Launch imd/acc's Sepolia test run 6 from this repository (the launch-sepolia branch, which is the sepolia branch without .github/workflows; do not add any workflow file): deploy only the ProjectRegistry, exactly as launch.json lists it, wired to test run 2's live Stacker and to IdentityMD's Intake v2. This registry is the code the mainnet registry will use, with Sepolia settings: test run 5's registry (launch #1428, 0x5f63cdead0f5f693b8964d82b56155f55645ccea, tested live: a rejection, a listing and a defended challenge) with one rule text clarified, version 3.1 of the panel rules. Under version 3 the trader rule said "reject ... forwarding-router recipients", which some panel members read as any contract a router's msgSender() reports; version 3.1 says the router itself is rejected and the address msgSender() reports is a valid trader even when it is a contract. Rehearsed on Sepolia with a real panel: 11 of 11 true. Only that string changed. This run tests it live before mainnet. imd/acc pays trading cashback to traders as staked IMD (sIMD), 0.25% to 1% of each trade at each project's choice, funded from the project's existing fees; only credits from listed projects earn points.

DEPLOY (Sepolia, one contract):
- ProjectRegistry(intake, oracleAsset, stacker, oracleSigner, questionChainId, challengeBond, challengeCooldown) = (0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82 Intake v2, 0x44a1cd38474fb1748400e7deb5f8d786cce3f89a Sepolia test IMD, 0x0457276d7b036818b3eddc1a4a3fceda61e9314d the live Stacker of launch #1294, 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982 oracle signer, 1, 5e18, 3600). launch.json already lists exactly this.
- Do not deploy a Stacker, TestIMD or TestSIMD. The Stacker at 0x0457...314d is live on the live TestIMD 0x2b69...1e82 and TestSIMD 0xf9e2...1cc1 of launch #1129 (it is src/Stacker.sol without the mainnet InvalidTrader check; test/SepoliaFork.t.sol checks that), and PLEA's hook and the trial venue already credit through it. The registry only names the Stacker in its questions and never calls it.
- src/ProjectRegistry.sol and src/oracle/OracleAttestation.sol stay as they are: no owner; the constructor makes no external call. applyListing(project, name, sourceUrl, rateBps 25-100, beneficiary): when the project reports an owner through owner() (projectOwner: a staticcall capped at 30,000 gas reading at most 32 bytes; a revert, a malformed answer or zero means no owner), only that owner or the project itself may apply (NotProjectOwner, before any fee); a project without an owner can be applied for by anyone. Anyone may challengeForBeneficiary(project, reason, beneficiary) a listed project after its cooldown. Each ask pays the oracle fee read live from the Intake (ORACLE_FEE(), 0.5 test IMD), plus the bond for a challenge, and asks Intake v2 one yes-or-no question with requestWithFailure, with the 8 rules of version 3.1 (docs/panel-rules-v2.md: the trader is valid router hookData, else the router's msgSender(), else sender only if it has no code, never tx.origin; the router itself is rejected, a contract msgSender() reports is a valid trader; LP fees and returns to the trader, owner or team do not count toward the fee guard), each under 512 characters. onOracleResult (0x510379c7) accepts only the Intake, only its own open request, each answer once, only a signature by the oracle signer for this contract issued after the ask (300-second tolerance), from a panel of 15 with at least 11 agreeing: yes lists from that block, or keeps a challenged project (bond to its beneficiary, cooldown not restarted); no rejects, or delists from that block (bond back). onOracleFailure (0xa7980e31) only clears the open question and returns a bond; expire clears one after a day or once the Intake completed it. A bond the token refuses is recorded in bondOwed and claimed with claimBond(to). setBeneficiary waits while a question is open and changes the wallet at most once per day. Questions are filed under chain 1 (the oracle has no Sepolia RPC) and give the real chain id in the text.
- test/mocks and test/trial hold test doubles and the trial contracts only (SelfCredit, the negative case; TrialVenue, the positive case, live at 0xf2520b379021ae989bb0ebbd350a0c8571256fef). Keep foundry.toml as it is (solc 0.8.26, cancun, 10,000 runs, bytecode_hash none).

FACTS (read on Sepolia 2026-10-12, block 11,900,766): Intake v2 is live (callback gas 1,000,000) and sells the question for 0.5 of the test IMD, which anyone can mint. TestSIMD is not paused. The registry's runtime is 23,295 bytes; deploying it estimates about 36.7M gas on Sepolia's current schedule (test run 5's registry deployed through the factory at block 11,899,694). The trial venue 0xf252...6fef reports owner() 0x4b91...6821.

TESTS: forge test passes (246 tests on this branch: 232 run offline; 12 fork tests run when ETH_RPC_URL and SEPOLIA_RPC_URL are set, and 2 mainnet-manifest checks skip because this launch.json is the Sepolia one). test/RegistryPolicyRevision.t.sol checks the version 3.1 trader rule's text; test/RegistryApplicantGate.t.sol owner-only applications; test/Deployment.t.sol this manifest; test/RegistrySepoliaFork.t.sol a real application to Intake v2 as the project's owner. Keep all of them passing.

README: once live, add the registry's address as "Sepolia test run 6" in the Deployments table.
